maya (PM): Kickoff: 'fallback routing' — short sync tomorrow? Need sequencing + launch gates.

sam (Eng): +1. quick Q: family-level fallback or per-tenant?

jordan (Runtime): Start family-level to reduce risk. Per-tenant as opt-in later. We can ship family fallback + cached-prefix in ~1w.

leila (Infra): Family fallback needs a small reserved prewarm pool and autoscale limit. Need burst estimate.

maya (PM): Estimate: 2x baseline for first 24h, pilot cap 100 req/s per tenant.

ethan (Security): Regulated tenants: default no fallback to quantized/alternate models unless opted-in. Require audit events for fallback decisions.

alex (SRE): Add metric fallback_rate{tenant,route,variant}. Page if >5% for 5m. Runbook to disable per-tenant fallback.

sam (Eng): Will add event fields (model_id, reason). Small proto change, ETA 3d.

jordan (Runtime): Plan: A) exact-variant route if available B) family-compatible fallback C) cached-prefix degrade. A+B in 1w.

leila (Infra): Staging pool suggestion:
prewarm_pool: reserved, gpu:4, min:2, max:12, scale_metric: rps, threshold:200

maya (PM): Acceptance criteria draft:
- Canary 5% for 48h, fallback_rate <2%
- Quality checks: prompt-set delta <3%
- Security signoff on allowed variants + audit events
- Infra prewarm + rollback controls

ethan (Security): I'll produce a short policy doc by EOD Fri.

alex (SRE): I'll build dashboard + runbook in 3d.

sam (Eng): Rollout steps: feature flag, proto change (3d), runtime alpha (4d), infra staging (2d), canary (2d).

maya (PM): Actions: sam RFC+PR (24h), jordan alpha (1w), leila infra pool (3d), ethan policy (EOD Fri), alex dashboard (3d). Scheduling 15m sync tomorrow 10:30am PT.

deploy-bot: reminder set for "fallback routing sync" tomorrow 10:30am PT in #product.

maya (PM): Rollback thresholds: fallback_rate >5% for 15m OR p95 > SLA +150ms for 15m => rollback. OK?

jordan (Runtime): OK. We'll expose API to flip fallback off.

leila (Infra): Will wire API to autoscaler and add console kill-switch.

sam (Eng): I'll add tests simulating region model loss to verify rollback triggers.

ethan (Security): Event schema will include tenant_id, decision_reason, model_id, triggering_metric. Sharing by EOD.

maya (PM): Thanks. I'll capture these as the sprint handoff and tag owners. No objections, proceed. :rocket:
